author: half_life6
quote: 13 Years of Waiting for This? A Beautiful Game With a Soulless Story.10/10 graphics and physics. 0/10 storytelling.After 13 years of waiting, I honestly expected Rockstar to deliver something that would redefine GTA, not a game that looks incredible but leaves me completely disappointed with its characters and ****’s be honest: the graphics, physics, world design and technical aspects are absolutely phenomenal. But a GTA game isn’t just about graphics. It’s about personality, satire, unforgettable characters, freedom and a story that actually makes you care. And for me, GTA 6 completely fails in that department.Lucia feels incredibly overrated. Instead of giving us a genuinely complex, naturally written female protagonist, it feels like the writers are trying too hard to make a statement about female empowerment. Empowerment isn’t the problem; poor writing is. A strong character doesn’t need to constantly feel like she’s being presented as superior just to prove a point. It should feel natural, not forced. And unfortunately, Lucia’s characterization comes across as more artificial than **** Jason? Honestly, one of the most disappointing protagonists I’ve experienced. I found his personality bland, his delivery unconvincing and his overall presence lacking the charisma you’d expect from a GTA lead character. I simply couldn’t connect with him. He feels forgettable in a franchise that has given us some of gaming’s most iconic **** story itself feels like it’s trying too hard to push certain themes instead of focusing on what made GTA special in the first place: bold satire, unpredictable characters, dark humor, genuinely entertaining storytelling and a world where the writing doesn’t feel afraid to offend **** feels like Rockstar has lost some of the identity that made this franchise legendary. A game can be progressive, provocative and modern without making its characters feel artificially constructed around an agenda. And it can criticize society without making the narrative feel one-sided.After 13 years, I expected an unforgettable story. What I got was a technically incredible game with a story and protagonists that, personally, I couldn’t **** rating:Graphics & physics: 10/10Story: 0/10Jason: 0/10Lucia: 0/10A masterpiece technically. A disappointment narratively. Shame, Rockstar. 13 years for this.
